PREVENTIVE_OVERSPEND.diagnosis: At the current spending rate in '{category}', the monthly limit of {limit} will be exceeded by {overage}.
PREVENTIVE_OVERSPEND.action: Reduce daily spending in '{category}' by {daily_reduction} for the remaining {remaining_days} day(s) of the month.
PREVENTIVE_OVERSPEND.projected_effect: Stay within the monthly budget limit of {limit}.

OPTIMISATION_INACTIVE.diagnosis: The '{category}' recurring charge ({avg_monthly}/mo) has not been recorded for {days_inactive} days.
OPTIMISATION_INACTIVE.action: Review and consider cancelling subscriptions in '{category}'. Cancellation could save {annual_saving} per year.

OPTIMISATION_ANOMALY.diagnosis: Last month's '{category}' spend ({latest}) is {z_score} standard deviations above the historical average ({avg}).
OPTIMISATION_ANOMALY.action: Review recent transactions in '{category}'. The unusual excess of {excess} may represent a one-off purchase that can be excluded from regular budget planning.

STRATEGIC_SURPLUS.action: Transfer {transfer_amount} to a savings account ({savings_pct}% of the surplus).
STRATEGIC_SURPLUS.projected_effect: Annual savings potential: {annual_potential} if maintained monthly.
